nom: SACHEU Hydra-Peel Off Moisture Seal Mask

segments.mature: One reviewer, aged 71, reports the mask improved skin appearance and seemed to diminish some wrinkles with repeated use.

concerns.aging: A 71-year-old reviewer reports repeated use diminished some wrinkles and improved her skin's appearance overall.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report strong hydrating and moisture-locking effects, describing skin as glassy, smooth, glowy or bouncy the next morning; one reviewer found it only 'ok' for hydrating and was unimpressed.

aspects.libelle: Plastic or play-dough scent when applied
Stays on overnight without transferring to pillow
Pulls or tightens uncomfortably while worn

extraits.texte: It's just ok. Definitely doesn't peel off very easily and ok as far as hydrating. I wasn't very impressed with this product.

extraits.titre: Could be better, but still recommend
extraits.texte: Firstly, this is small! Its 1oz of product, making it like 3x the cost per oz of similar products. There's also a plastic almost play dough smell to the product. Not terrible, and it does go away after dry down. The product does preform, if you do it correctly. This is for restore/recovery nights, not treatment nights. Whenever your skin needs a break, but you still want to do something, this is a great pick. You'll want to apply hydration products FIRST. A hydrating toner/essance, maybe a hyaluronic acid serum or other hydration focused serum, AND a moisturizer, ALL BEFORE THIS PRODUCT. Its not 1 and done, its a complimentary tool. once your hydrating skincare has absorbed for a min or two, use 2 pumps per section of your face. so 2 pumps on left cheek, 2 pumps on the right, and 2 pumps on your forehead. Spread it around. It takes like 10 mins to fully set. Once its dried down, you're done! Its amazing since once its dry, its not sticky. If your pillow case gets gross from skincare, this completely prevents it. Also stops hair from sticking Next morning you can peel it off, or wash it off. The residue comes off with just a few splashes of water. Skin is SO glowy and bouncy. Like it really does make a difference. Makeup looks way better if you use it a few hours before application. Overall a good product. Size for the price is iffy. Product preference is great, just keep in mind this is a final step product, not a do-it-all. And it preforms best overnight!

This was kind of a sensory nightmare for me, it was so sticky. It didn't peel off in one piece, just kind of rolled off in hundreds of little black pieces. I only used it once, so I can't speak of any skincare benefits. It reminded me of a Pyunkang Yul product, but I think the PY product is better as you don't have to roll it off your face in. ton of little pieces. And it actually makes a difference in the morning.

I love the results when i used it overnight. My face was glassy, smooth, bright even skin tone, and pores were definitely smaller almost invisible. It definitely made my skincare products worked better and deeper. Will definitely use it again and again. It's a good efficacy booster and get more results from skincare products.

I have tried this product a couple of times now. The first time was for overnight -- I thought this would be easier than those other masks that flop all over the place while sleeping, but it seemed to pull in certain areas around my face, waking me up a couple of times. However, both doing it overnight and during the day for the recommended couple of hours made a huge improvement on the appearance of my skin. Not just felt softer, but seemed to have diminished some of my wrinkles, and that's huge... I'm 71. Yes, definitely would buy again.

extraits.titre: Love this for an overnight wrapping mask.
extraits.texte: I kept seeing "overnight wrapping masks" on Tik Tok so I bought & tried a few but didn't love any of them. This one isn't called a wrapping mask, but it works perfect for me. I do my night time skincare, cover my face in Aquaphor, and put this Moisture Seal Mask on top. I didn't think it would dry b/c I was putting it on a face of Aquaphor BUT it dries, stays on all night, locks in moisture all night long, and easily peels off in the morning. I'll be purchasing more from this brand after seeing how great this product is.

extraits.titre: Peels Easily, but Results Are Instant.
extraits.texte: Finally, a vegan wrapping mask! The mask does lift in the course of normal functions, like yawning. However, when I woke up, my skin was glowing. It even looks luminescent after washing my face. I wish the product was bigger, though. This will not last long.

reserve: The sample is small (10 reviews) and only one reviewer specifies an age-related concern, so conclusions for skin types other than mature and for concerns beyond dehydration and aging are not supported.
